jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team**,** Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

** Eurodrone Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineer (d/f/m)**

Are you passionate about shaping the future of Airbus Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) products? Join our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team for Eurodrone and contribute your skills and enthusiasm to our dynamic Chief Engineering Organization. As such, execute overall design and steering activities to ensure a consistent RPAS design and integration across all functions and through the entire lifecycle, compliant with top level system requirements. Steer the flight chain (Ground Safety Critical Control Station, Flight Management System, Safe Flight and Landing System) as an integral part of the overall RPAS design and ensure the compliance with all overall RPAS design activities.

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Coordinate the flight chain design (GSCCS, FMCS, FMAIS, SFLS), ensuring consistent safety-critical design.
- Ensure RPA compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.
- Control the RPA and flight chain technical baseline and design changes, Assessing the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS architecture and aircraft configuration, ensuring configuration maturity aligns with programme milestones and safety objectives.
- Lead the definition of the certification and qualification roadmap for in close alignment with customer and regulatory bodies.
- Integrate and coordinate Flight Physics activities (performance, HQ, loads) and drive flight chain consistent solutions into the overall configuration.
- Achieving the handling quality requirements for the RPAS failure free and for failure cases.
- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.
- Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level.

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Significant Engineering experience > 8 years in related area.
- You have excellent leadership skills and profound experience in leading teams.
- Deep knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws.
- Extensive experience in the development of Flight Control Systems.
- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.
- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design.
- Operational knowledge on UAS or aircraft Operation, in particular Automatic Take Off and Landing.
- Proven track record in project management and technical management.
- Excellent coordination and communication skills.
- Goal-oriented mind set and good analytical skills.
- Very strong team player.
- Exceptional English language skills (Negotiation Level).

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

**Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM**

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D] (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us Global protein consumption is skyrocketing—especially meat.
And that’s creating massive challenges for health, climate, and
animal welfare. At Project Eaden, we’re tackling this head-on with
our patented fiber spinning technology: plant-based meat with
authentic texture and taste. Our LEKKA products are already in
millions of homes across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Your
mission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skills
to food production technology, this is your chance to develop
innovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, this
is your chance to take the next step and take operational
responsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing,
purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation &
Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment,
perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conduct
functional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.
Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes and
equipment performance, identify improvements, and design modifications
to increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance.
Implement optimizations in the production environment. Equipment
Repair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical,
integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complex
issues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automation
equipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.
Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanical
prototypes and operational processes, validate design performance
through testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on production
feedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration:
Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimize
equipment performance and resolve complex production challenges.
Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to production
planning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintain
comprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics,
mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.
Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with external
vendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurement
activities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure project
deliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll be
responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing
mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and
supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production
operations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on
everything from equipment design to production support. Requirements
Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering
experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with
exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated
systems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical
Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or
related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance,
reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of
food industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge of
manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques,
familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshooting
abilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions and
diagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiency
with CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing software
systems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving
abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process
troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop
longlasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility:
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt
quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Language
Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level
in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Why us? Why you should apply now Scaling Big: We’re at an exciting
inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling
operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the
ground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and
angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is
Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating
irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away
from animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values
and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We
welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age,
color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation,
gender identity, or marital status. Workspace and culture We’re
building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our
team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of
face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively.
Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace in
Berlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over the
next few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace,
blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of our
shared values and connection.

Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a globally operating company and a leading provider of innovative metrology and process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.

With around 1,600 employees, 4 research and development centers, and 31 locations worldwide, we deliver valuable insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage a variety of technological disciplines – including physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms – to develop hardware and software solutions that measure virtually every modern computer chip in the world. Nova looks down to the atomic level, gains unique insights through dimensional, material, and chemical metrology, and provides customers with actionable data. This enables us to tackle critical challenges with differentiated solutions. Our exceptional, people-focused, and innovation-driven corporate culture ensures that every individual at Nova has the opportunity to make a real impact and push the boundaries of what is technologically possible.

Sentronics Metrology GmbH was recently acquired by Nova and is a leading company in the field of high-precision measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Based in Mannheim, Sentronics brings over 25 years of experience in developing state-of-the-art metrology systems. The integration of Sentronics is already well underway. Sentronics is now a permanent part of the Nova family and shares the same values: innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction. The combination of Nova’s global presence and Sentronics’ advanced technology and expertise create a unique platform for growth and innovation. As part of Nova, Sentronics will fully benefit from the exciting opportunities in the rapidly evolving semiconductor industry.

As Head of Product Marketing (m/f/d) at Sentronics Metrology (a Nova Company) in Mannheim, you will take on a key leadership role in driving the divisional product marketing strategy for our high-precision metrology solutions within the semiconductor industry. Your mission is to translate complex technological capabilities into clear market value, expand our footprint with key global customers, and lead the full product lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D, Sales, and Application teams.

We are looking for creative minds with high ambitions who see the seemingly impossible as a challenge and love to achieve innovative breakthroughs in a global, multidisciplinary team.

Please submit your application in English.

For questions, feel free to contact us at talents@novami.com (https://mailto:talents@novami.com) .

Responsibilities

- Leading divisional product management, marketing, and application development activities
- Driving the divisional product development lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D and Sales
- Developing and driving competitive positioning and value propositions to enable regional sales success
- Driving technical review meetings with key customers to expand Sentronics AP market share
- Representing Sentronics at global trade shows, including SEMICON, and delivering speaking engagements at technology conferences
- Aligning with internal and external stakeholders on customer demo development and execution
- ·Aligning cross-divisional segmentation strategies with other Nova divisions
- Acting as the primary representative of Sentronics/Nova across all company-wide marketing initiatives and events

Requirements

- Strong scientific background with at least a Master’s degree, preferably in Physics, Optics, or a related field
- 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in leading technical marketing/product management activities within the semiconductor WFE environment
- Deep, hands-on expertise in metrology requirements within semiconductor fabs
- Proven experience in working with key customers in the semiconductor industry (10B+ USD CapEx)
- Excellent Business-English communication skills, both verbal and written
- High willingness to travel internationally (up to 50%)

Benefits:

- Financial Wellbeing:  Receive a tax- and duty-free cash bonus of €100 per month to use flexibly through our discounts platform and with premium suppliers. Birthday gifts and other non-cash allowance bonuses are also included.
- Overall Wellbeing: Enjoy a free, generous breakfast with fresh fruit, a subsidized lunch, as well as free coffee, tea, and water. Take part in team events, company events, and volunteering activities.
- Flexibility & Time Off: Benefit from a hybrid work environment with flexible hours, remote work options, and flextime. You can also work up to 20 days per year from any country in Europe.
- Job Security: Work for a globally leading provider in the semiconductor industry that is continuously growing and focused on long-term success.
- Professional Development: Continuously develop your skills with individual training programs and our tailored learning platform.

About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-minded Founding CTO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take ownership of our technology and play a leading role in product development. You will work closely with the Founder & CEO on company strategy, product direction and execution. We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. Your challenge will be to turn this foundation into a scalable technology platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many.

What You’ll Do

- Own our technology strategy and architecture and help shape our product strategy and roadmap.
- Design and build scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital products.
- Stay hands-on across the stack and make key decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure.
- Develop our AI capabilities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction and workflow automation.
- Work directly with users, employers and domain experts. As we grow, you will build and lead HeyGermany’s product and engineering team.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on development skills.
- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software
- Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred.
- A proven track record of shipping a real product end-to-end in a leading technical role, for example as a founder, founding engineer, startup CTO or technical lead.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in your day-to-day work.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer and business problems into pragmatic product and technical decisions.
- The ability to move fast in an early-stage environment and make good trade-offs between speed, quality and scalability.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission. You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about the business beyond technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global
- Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product, technology and company strategy, with the opportunity to build our architecture and future engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy. If this is a company you would like to help build, we would like to hear from you.

Send one thing you've built that you're proud of, and tell us why this mission matters to you.

katharina@hey-germany.com

We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.

Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the our revolutionary Glassomer technology, silica nanocomposites which can be processed like a polymer and subsequently converted to pure fused silica, with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
You will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Development of novel silica nanocomposites for additive manufacturing and extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigation and characterization of nanocomposite systems and glasses, including processing behavior, structural, thermal, rheological, and optical properties.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: stereolithography-based 3D printing, extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software

You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment

Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
